buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider

2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses List of Document to be supplied I. Eligibility Criteria: - The bidder should have a. Valid GST Registration Certificate. b. Average Annual financial turnover during the any last 3 out of 5 financial years, ending 31st March of the previous financial year (2024-25), should be at least 30% of the estimated cost of the respective zon e. Turnover Certificate duly audited and certified by a Chartered Accountant with Valid UDIN (Unique Docu ment Identity Number) number should be submitted. Year in which no turnover is shown would also be con sidered for working out the average. II. WORK Experience: The bidder should have work experience of having successfully/satisfactorily comp leted “EARTHING OF TELECOM TOWERS/EXCHANGES/SYSTEMS’ works during last FIVE financial years 2021 -22 , 2022-23,2023-24,2024-25 & 2025-26 and till the last date of previous month of publication of NIT wit h minimum value of 35% of the estimated cost of respective zone(s), for BSNL/MTNL/licensed TSPs (Teleco m Service Providers)/any Govt /PSU. The satisfactory work experience certificate for the said work submitt ed should be issued by an officer not below the equivalent rank of TDM/DGM/SE of BSNL/MTNL or Circle/Te chnical Heads of the licensed TSP. In case of non-availability of work experience certificates of licensed TSP s, the Work Completion Certificate or Purchase Order copy along with corresponding Invoice Copies or Ge M Contract copies along with the copies of the GeM-CRAC/GeM Invoices may be considered for accep tance. (III) FORMAT OF UNDERTAKING for Non-Blacklisting by the Bidder: Declaration to be subm itted by the Bidder that the Company/ Partnership is not black-listed/ debarred by any PSU or State/UT or Central Government in India as on <the date of the submission of bid> as attached in Annexure-VII in Buyer added ATC (IV) EMD (Bid Security): (a) The DD may be drawn in favour 'Accounts officer (A & P) O/o CGM BSNL Odisha Circle, Bhubane swar' payable at Bhubaneswar. It should reach the AGM (CPC-II), O/o CGM BSNL, Odisha Circle, BS NL Bhawan, Ashok Nagar, Bhubaneswar -751009 before the bid opening date. ‘OR’ (b) EMD-BG for the EMD amount with validity one month above the offer validity period subject to maximum 210 days in the format attached under 'Bid Specific ATC. ‘OR’ Appropriate supporting document for exemption of EMD. (V) GSTIN document: Full page of the GST Registration certificate with all the Annexure showing the details of “Constitut ion of Business” and details of the proprietor/ directors/partners etc of the bidder-firm.

(VI) Make in India (MII): To be given in the attached format given under “Bid specific ATC” (VII) Near Relationship Certificate: The bidder should give a certificate that none of his/her near relative, as defined below, is workin g in the BSNL units. In case of bidder being proprietorship firm, this certificate will be given by the proprietor. For partnership firm, the certificate will be given by all the partners. In case of bidder b eing Company/Limited Company the certificate will be given by all the Directors of the company, b ut excluding following: a. Government of India/Financial institution nominees and independent non-Official part time Direc tors, appointed by Govt. of India or the Governor of the state and b. Full time Directors of PSUs, both Central and State NB: The near relatives for this purpose are defined as: - (a) Members of a Hindu undivided family. (b) They are husband and wife. (c) The one is related to the other in the manner as father, mother, son(s) & Son's wife (daughter i n law), Daughter(s) and daughter's husband (son in law), brother(s) and brother's wife, sister(s) a nd sister's husband (brother-in-law). (VIII) Payment process: After supply of the material as per the contract/Purchase Order, the suc cessful bidder has to submit their claim invoice to the automated vendor invoice processing portal (VIPA) through their registered mail. In this regard, they have to submit their option for registratio n to the portal before submission of the invoice. A document containing the Option form for registr ation and guidelines for submission of invoice is available vide Annexure-VI under Bid Specific ATC document. NB-1: Bidders are required to upload scanned copies of the following documents to fulfil the EMD/Perfor mance Security (which ever applicable). i) Bank Transaction details with UTR Number towards the successful e-payment for EMD. (Mandate Form containing BSNL Bank A/C details is attached at Annexure-VIII of ATC documents) ii) DD/ Banker Cheque or Bank Guarantee iii) Valid MSE Certificate /Udyam Registration certificate (for Micro & Small Enterprise claiming exe mptions from Tender Fee/ EMD) iv) The original document of the EMD-DD or EMD-BG should reach the AGM(CPC-II), O/o CGMT, BSN L Odisha Circle, Bhubaneswar-751009 within 5(five) days from the bid end date. Else, the bid offer will be treated as without EMD. NB-2: 1) Documents submitted/uploaded post Technical Evaluation shall not be entertained. 2) It may be noted that AWO/APO shall be issued to successful L1 bidder prior to placement of Ge M Contract Order. The successful L1 bidder is required to show the Original eligibility criteria docu ments i.e. Experience Certificates & Annual Financial Turnover as uploaded by the bidder in GeM p

ortal during bidding process to the Committee for Evaluation of Tender (CET), Chaired by DGM () O/o CG M BSNL Odisha Circle, BSNL Bhawan, Unit-II, Ashok Nagar, Bhubaneswar for verification within 7(seven)da ys of issue of the APO/AWO. NB-3:Submission of Irrelevant, Unnecessary repeat documents should be avoided. NB-4: The bidder shall provide single quote in Rupees (including GST) against tot al estimated cost schedule wise on GeM portal. The % variation will be applicabl e equally on all line items . 3.
